notes: Summary: enterprise helpdesk vendor looking to replace in-house retrieval + heuristics with embeddings + learned reranker for ticket deflection.
Primary goal: push deflection rate from 28% -> 50% while keeping automated response latency <= 200ms end-to-end for served-queries.
Scale: currently ~12M historical tickets + knowledge articles; expect index to grow to ~50M documents after onboarding partner content and KB exports.
Traffic profile: bursty during EMEA morning and US afternoon. Typical QPS 50-250 for deflection path; peak spikes to 1200 for enterprise tenants.
Cost sensitivity: CFO flagged token/embedding cost as core procurement risk — target cost per query (embedding + rerank) target < $0.005 for average query given batching & caching.

Model preferences: open models acceptable. Interested in quantized Llama2-type encoders for dense embeddings + lightweight transformer reranker for top-5 reordering. Wants fallbacks to smaller models if latency SLO threatened.
Latency SLOs: p50 retrieval+rerank < 120ms, p95 < 300ms. For UI flow must feel instant (<200ms perceived).
Security: must run under customer VPC with SSO integration; strict audit logs, KMS-managed keys, and 7-year retention/archival policy for eDiscovery.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-14 call: 'We need best-in-class rerank for top-5 — if we hand users noisy top-1 answers we'll regress CSAT. Also don't blow away our infra costs.'
Prefer Dedicated for predictable throughput; Private (on-prem) required for two regulated clients in finance vertical.
Requested deliverables: POC plan, perf benchmarks (end-to-end), cost model (per-query at scale), security doc mapping to their checklist.
Internal contacts: Head of ML - Priya Khatri (will provide labeled rerank set), Infra Lead - Omar Reyes (ops questions about GPU footprint).
Redwood AE notes: strong technical buyer group; procurement timeline tied to CFO + legal review. Coffee chat with CTO went well.
